FlexiPage.description: Standalone hub page for the Event Speaker Cockpit roster board - not attached to any existing record page, reachable as its own tab in the Sales app.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
How to use this board

  • Pick an event from the dropdown above the board to see its speaker roster.
  • Use search and the filter dropdown to narrow a large roster down - for example, to just the speakers still missing a bio.
  • Click a chip (Bio, Photo, Cal. Invite, Briefing, Thank You) to cycle it through outstanding, done, and declined.
  • Select multiple cards with the checkbox to move or update several speakers at once.
  • Click a speaker's name to open their contact record, or the small icon on a card to open the underlying speaker record.
